_note: Every fact used on the page about Barclays, each with the source it was read from. Figures reported by more than one outlet carry the primary outlet first.

facts.label: Jobs to go by end of 2026
facts.quote: British lender Barclays has revealed plans to cut 5,000 jobs — about 5% of its total workforce — as part of an artificial intelligence-linked efficiency push.

facts.label: Share of global workforce
facts.quote: The FTSE 100 bank's reductions will cover five per cent of the group's global workforce and are expected to be mainly concentrated in support functions, including developers.

facts.label: Barclays colleagues worldwide
facts.quote: Providing employment to c.93,000 colleagues globally (Barclays PLC Annual Report 2025). The Companies Act headcount measure in the same report, which counts people rather than full-time equivalents and includes colleagues on long-term leave, is 98,141 at 31 December 2025.

facts.label: Roles already gone in H1 2026
facts.quote: Around 1,000 roles were cut in the first half, the bank said, with the remaining balance to be cut in the third and fourth quarter.

facts.label: Share of cuts in support functions
facts.quote: Staff reduction: approximately 5,000 full-time employees, with 60% of the impact occurring in support functions. (Q3 2026 earnings call.) CNBC: About 60% of the cuts are expected to be in support functions, including developers, according to the earnings presentation.
facts.source: Barclays Q3 2026 earnings call transcript (The Motley Fool) and CNBC, 22 October 2026

facts.label: Gross efficiency savings targeted for 2027
facts.quote: Having increased this for 2026 alone, we expect more than GBP 1.1 billion of gross efficiency savings in 2027. These actions involve an expected reduction of circa 5,000 full-time employees.
facts.source: Barclays Q3 2026 earnings call, 22 October 2026 (transcript via The Motley Fool)

facts.label: Q3 2026 pre-tax profit
facts.quote: Barclays' third-quarter pre-tax profit rose 12% year on year to £2.3 billion ($3.1 billion), matching LSEG-compiled forecasts.

facts.label: CEO on AI's role
facts.display: "AI is the icing on the cake, not the cake."
facts.quote: Venkat said the use of AI in the firm was "the icing on the cake, not the cake".
facts.source: C.S. Venkatakrishnan, Barclays group chief executive, quoted by City A.M., 22 October 2026

facts.label: CEO on which roles
facts.display: "Primarily related to operational and functional roles that service our business."
facts.quote: "They're across the bank and they are primarily related to operational and functional roles that service our business… it's a result of the investments which we've made in technology over a number of years and which we'll continue to make," Barclays boss CS Venkatakrishnan, known as Venkat, said.

timeline.label: Barclays is estimated to have cut about 5,000 jobs worldwide in 2023, roughly 5% of staff, in a cost-cutting drive that began in late 2023.
Investor update: Barclays sets a target of £2bn of gross efficiency savings by 2026 across people, property and infrastructure.
Full-year 2025 results. The annual report puts the workforce at c.93,000 colleagues worldwide.
Around 1,000 roles have already gone in the first half of 2026.
Q3 results: about 5,000 roles, roughly 5% of the global workforce, to go by the end of 2026. Around 60% are in support functions, including developers.
Chief executive C.S. Venkatakrishnan: AI is 'the icing on the cake, not the cake'. The roles are 'primarily operational and functional roles that service our business'.
Target: more than £1.1bn of gross efficiency savings in 2027.
timeline.source: Barclays Q3 2026 earnings call (transcript via The Motley Fool)

context_stats.label: Share of US work tasks an LLM alone could do significantly faster at the same quality
context_stats.quote: Our analysis suggests that, with access to an LLM, about 15% of all worker tasks in the US could be completed significantly faster at the same level of quality.
context_stats.source: Eloundou, Manning, Mishkin and Rock, 'GPTs are GPTs' (2023; Science, 2024)

context_stats.label: Share of tasks with LLM-powered software on top
context_stats.quote: When incorporating software and tooling built on top of LLMs, this share increases to between 47 and 56% of all tasks.
context_stats.source: Eloundou, Manning, Mishkin and Rock, 'GPTs are GPTs' (2023; Science, 2024)

context_stats.label: UK workers in occupations with tasks AI could perform or enhance
context_stats.quote: Around 70% of UK workers are in occupations containing tasks that AI could potentially perform or enhance, according to IMF estimates.
context_stats.source: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology and AI Security Institute, 'Assessment of AI capabilities and the impact on the UK labour market', 28 January 2026
